items.title: Freeze replacement vocabulary for Authority Server retirement
items.context: Document canonical replacements: admissibilityStatus, assuranceLevel, evidenceScope, gate-consumed local evidence; define forbidden Authority Server terms.
items.userSees: Source docs define local admissibility vocabulary and say Authority Server is retired from the core CLI path.

happy.desc: Canonical docs define admissibilityStatus, assuranceLevel, and evidenceScope as the replacement vocabulary.

edge.desc: Legacy Authority Server docs are not treated as active implementation guidance.

adversarial.desc: Docs do not present productionDone/fullAuthorityDone/authorityDone as attainable local CLI states.

verificationEvidence.note: Replacement vocabulary is enforced on active docs/runtime surfaces: admissibilityStatus, assuranceLevel, evidenceScope, local gate evidence, signed/offline receipt bundles, and local review quorum.
Retired decision-doc allowlist is checked near the top for retired/legacy/out-of-core/superseded markers, so legacy Authority Server docs are not active implementation guidance.
Guard rejects active productionDone/fullAuthorityDone/authorityDone server-receipt claim surfaces; docs now frame local admissibility/status instead of attainable local Authority completion.

items.title: Clean user-facing docs and host prompts
items.context: Replace Authority Server/production receipt/no-Authority phrasing in README/docs/.lattice-codex/.claude with local admissibility wording.
items.userSees: Host prompts and generated templates describe local proof admissibility instead of warning about Authority Server claims.

happy.desc: Agent templates and generated Codex/Claude prompt copies use local admissibility/assurance wording.

edge.desc: Regeneration source templates are updated, not only generated copies.

adversarial.desc: Authority Server, receiptVerified, productionDone, authorityDone, and fullAuthorityDone warning blocks do not remain in active prompt assets.

verificationEvidence.note: README, docs/guide, agent templates, Codex prompt copies, and Claude prompt copies no longer advertise active Authority Server receipt dependency.
Guard scans packages/main/templates/agents plus generated .lattice-codex/.claude prompt copies, proving source templates were updated as well as generated assets.
Active prompt assets are scanned for Authority Server, receiptVerified, productionDone, authorityDone, and fullAuthorityDone claim wording; smoke passed on current HEAD.

items.title: Remove server-backed Authority command surface
items.context: Remove authority_* server commands and config allowlist entries; preserve unrelated local proof/admissibility commands.
items.userSees: lattice help no longer lists server-backed authority_status, authority receipt, authority job, or authority verdict commands.

happy.desc: Server-backed authority_* commands and aliases are removed from help, command catalog, activity policy, config, and registry registration.

edge.desc: Local proof/admissibility/quorum commands remain registered and documented as local assurance paths.

adversarial.desc: Alias forms like lattice authority status or lattice authority receipt verify are rejected or absent, not silently routed to obsolete handlers.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/command-catalog-smoke.js && node packages/main/dist/tasks/retired-authority-server-semantics-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: Retired server-backed Authority commands and nested aliases are removed from active command catalog/registry/policies and guarded from reintroduction.
Command catalog still passes with 257 commands and proof-admissibility smoke passes, showing local assurance/admissibility surfaces remain registered.
Retired nested aliases and flat authority_* command names are absent from MAIN_TOOLS and rejected by the guard negative self-check.

items.title: Delete or quarantine server-backed Authority implementation paths
items.context: Remove dead imports and server-backed modules/tests while preserving local receipt-bundle/quorum/admissibility logic.
items.userSees: Buildable CLI no longer imports server-backed Authority implementation paths while local receipt-bundle and proof-admissibility smokes still pass.

happy.desc: Server-backed Authority handler/core/task paths are removed from active imports and package scripts.

edge.desc: receipt-bundle, proof-admissibility, quorum_submit, and local review assurance tests still build and pass.

adversarial.desc: No compatibility shim keeps contacting LATTICE_AUTHORITY_URL or consuming server gate_decision receipts as active behavior.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/proof-admissibility-smoke.js && node packages/main/dist/tasks/receipt-bundle-contract-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: Server-backed Authority handler/tasks were deleted or quarantined from active runtime while proof-admissibility and receipt-bundle behavior still pass.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/proof-admissibility-smoke.js && node packages/main/dist/tasks/receipt-bundle-contract-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: Build, proof-admissibility smoke, and receipt-bundle contract smoke pass after deleting/quarantining server-backed Authority paths.
Guard scans active runtime surfaces for LATTICE_AUTHORITY_* and server receipt/gate-decision compatibility shims; current HEAD passes.

items.title: Add regression guard for retired Authority Server semantics
items.context: Add scanner/smoke that fails on reintroduced Authority Server command/product semantics outside explicit legacy/changelog/retirement allowlist.
items.userSees: retired-authority-server-semantics smoke passes and reports that retired Authority Server semantics are absent from active surfaces.

happy.desc: The new guard scans command catalog, aliases, docs, prompts, and templates for retired Authority Server product semantics.

edge.desc: The guard allows explicit legacy/retirement documentation if clearly marked and does not block local proof-admissibility or receipt-bundle wording.

adversarial.desc: A reintroduced server-backed authority command, env-mode guidance, or productionDone claim surface would fail the smoke.

verificationEvidence.note: Added retired Authority Server semantics guard with negative self-check for reintroduced active command/alias/server-receipt wording.

items.title: Validate, bump version, and finish story
items.context: Run build, targeted smokes, retired-term guard, lattice validate/DONE gates, then patch version if runtime behavior changed.
items.userSees: Build, retired-term guard, proof-admissibility smoke, receipt-bundle smoke, lattice validate, and the new CLI version all pass before DONE.

happy.desc: Build and targeted smokes pass after Authority Server retirement.

edge.desc: Version files are bumped only after runtime behavior changes are merged locally.

adversarial.desc: lattice validate/DONE gates do not rely on Authority Server receipt semantics after cleanup.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/retired-authority-server-semantics-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/proof-admissibility-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/receipt-bundle-contract-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/cli.js --version
